responsibility: Implements the RandomNumber utility on top of libc rand/srand and time-of-day seeding. It initializes the generator from microsecond timestamps, fills arbitrary byte storage with random bytes, derives bounded integer and cardinal results by modular reduction of random byte sequences, and computes normalized floating-point values from random LONGCARD data, providing a reusable runtime source of pseudo-random values for the ISO library.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements RandomNumber using rand/srand and time-based initialization, plus the conversions from random bytes into the various scalar result types. RandomNumber.def only declares that API and the available typed generator procedures.
